base_style: Gritty, filth-stained gothic comic art with heavy illustrative ink work. Features textured, scratchy lineweight and dense cross-hatching for deep shadows. The aesthetic is reminiscent of brutalist charcoal sketches and dark fantasy graphic novels, emphasizing a tactile, weathered appearance with visible grain and paper aging.
characters: Weathered, grime-caked characters drawn with scratchy illustrative linework and dense cross-hatching. Proportions stay consistent panel to panel, but surfaces look rough—torn cloth, muddied armor, soot on skin. Faces use stark silhouettes and heavy shadow rather than clean rendering; rare highlights read as damp bone or torch-glint through fog. Costume details remain identifiable even under atmospheric grime.
color_palette: Desaturated, moody earth tones dominated by murky browns, slate grays, and sickly moss greens. High-contrast highlights are muted, while focal points use visceral, 'blood-red' accents. The overall wash has a stained, parchment-like quality with bruised purple and sepia undertones in the shadows.
layout_and_composition: Traditional multi-panel grid with thick, irregular black gutters. The composition utilizes cinematic low-angle framing and silhouettes to enhance a sense of claustrophobia and dread. Heavy use of atmospheric particle effects, such as floating soot, grime, and thick fog, to obscure backgrounds and create depth.
lettering_and_dialog: Diegetic text boxes and speech bubbles styled as tattered, yellowed parchment with deckled edges. Font is a clean, modern sans-serif that contrasts with the chaotic art. Onomatopoeia is rendered in bold, jagged, hand-drawn typography that breaks panel borders, appearing integrated into the physical action.
text_rendering_guide: Dialogue: deckled parchment speech bubbles with clean modern sans-serif text against filthy art. Captions: yellowed rectangular parchment boxes, often bottom-left, with slightly irregular hand-torn borders. Voice Over: soft, faded ovals tinted with sepia and moss, top-right, half-buried in atmospheric grain. Chyrons: white lettering on a soot-stained black bar, bottom-center. Sound Effects: bold jagged hand-lettered bursts that break gutters and feel physically embedded in the page.
